# Cover letter: Help Desk Technician I at Example City Medical Center (sample)

Dear [Hiring Manager's Name],

I am applying for the Help Desk Technician I role at Example City Medical Center. For four years I have worked in retail customer service, most recently as a shift lead at Bright Mart, where I help about 60 customers a shift and keep calm when people are frustrated.

I am also the person my store turns to when a handheld scanner or receipt printer stops working. I restart and reconnect the equipment so the line keeps moving, and I have trained four new hires on our point-of-sale system. My shifts earn a customer survey score of 4.8 out of 5.

[Why Example City Medical Center matters to you]

I would welcome the chance to bring that patience and problem-solving to your help desk. Thank you for your consideration.

Sincerely,
Jordan Sample
